limitations: The exact classification is only for the largest zero in degrees four and five. Failure above the stated d endpoints concerns the complete-Bernstein/Pick property, not necessarily the weaker Bernstein property. The all-degree optimal largest-zero threshold remains open. A later revision of the motivating preprint remains an explicit originality risk because its updated full text was not verified.
